hook.name: LiquidityGateHook
hook.description: Only beforeAddLiquidity is hooked (swaps, removals and donations are not; no delta-returning flags). Liquidity can be added only by one address, through the canonical PositionManager (checked via its msgSender()). Pools on it use an ordinary fixed fee in their key; the hook never touches the fee. Not upgradeable, nothing configurable.
